title: Carve 0.2 forms at an opening brace
description: What the scan tries at an opening brace, in order: the entry with the lowest rank that matches is taken. Two entries with one rank are tried together.

rank.description: The place in the order, from 1.

name.description: A row of inline-atoms.json, or `braced_opener` for the braced rows of inline-delimiters.json.

opener.description: The characters the entry starts with.

condition.description: What must hold for the entry to match.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

closer.description: The closer the condition looks for.

marks.description: Characters. An entry is one character, or a range written as two characters joined by a hyphen, both ends included.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

otherwise.description: A brace that starts none of the entries.
